**To install:** download `ReleaseSync.exe` below and open it. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Then click **Install** when ReleaseSync asks.

**New in this version**

- **Follow source code.** A project with no releases can now be followed by its source code. ReleaseSync tracks the newest commit on its main branch, tells you when the code changes, and downloads it into the folder you choose. Turn it on from the "No releases" message, or for any project from its details.
- Source code is labelled as source code everywhere: Download source, Latest commit, and Open folder in place of Launch, since there's no program to run. No file inside the code is ever treated as the app.

Code signing: ReleaseSync is applying to use SignPath Foundation. See the [code signing policy](https://github.com/huskyCodes/ReleaseSync/blob/main/docs/CODE-SIGNING.md).

See the [project status](https://github.com/huskyCodes/ReleaseSync#project-status) for what's working and what's in progress.
